title: A fingerprint for a replacement plan
heading: When Plans Tie, Input Order Picks the Winner
cases: the same plan gives the same id, and moving one main to another year gives another id
two dicts with the same entries, built in different orders, are the same plan
two fresh Python processes with different hash seeds give the same id
main M1 in year 12 and main M11 in year 2 are different plans
